title: SymPy
description: Documented public symbolic mathematics library (SymPy Development Team (open source)) for the Hybrid Symbolic-Numeric Solver capability area.
body:
SymPy is a documented symbolic mathematics library from SymPy Development Team (open source). The Python library for symbolic mathematics: algebra, calculus, equation solving, and code generation, interoperating with numeric SciPy workflows.

How it works: It works by comparing the dimension vectors of every term in the equation against the first term's, flagging any term whose units disagree.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
